text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: 1st place, Matikanetannhauser—!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, I got 1st place!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wait, Matikanetannhauser got 1st place!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon ran a pretty incredible race too, but man,
you really never know what's gonna happen in a race...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-W-We did it~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ……Defeat……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Filled with towering expectations for Mihono Bourbon,
the racetrack was buzzing with a strange commotion.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Whew, you did it!
The very first step toward becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: At the next Japan Derby, I'll keep this momentum going—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, wait...
Is that... Bourbon-san?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Failing to win the Satsuki Sho...
means the Triple Crown is now impossible.
My father's and my one and only dream is—!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Oxygen supply levels lower than normal.
Cause unknown. Executing deep breaths immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*inhale*... *exhale*...
*inhale*... *exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...
...Phew... ...Next is the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even if the result is defeat,
I cannot afford to let my legs stop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon hurried on her way home.
As if chasing after her...
a small shadow came running up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Miss Bourbon...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...—No,
this isn't the time to be worrying, is it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice did terribly today.
At this rate... I'll never be able to reach Bourbon-san."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I can't become a Rice...
who makes everyone smile...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I need to become even, even stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. It's only natural to feel happy when you win and frustrated when you lose."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, to immediately set your sights on what's next with such fierce determination!
You're both truly incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! That was a wonderful victory,
congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Th-Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: And so, um, if it's all right, could you share a few words about your enthusiasm for the Nippon Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Enthusiasm!
Enthusiasm, enthusiasm... uuummm...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I won't lose either~!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: Mhm, mhm. "I won't lose"... got it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...
...Um, is that all...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! U-Understood...!
Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehe! I'll do my best~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has a rather laid-back air about her, but...
Knowing her, if she said she'll "do her best," she fully intends to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Japanese Derby.
I can't let it slip away!
